item.name: Lemon
item.cardSummary: Lemon is the baseline fruit stage. Use it to build the first economy, learn the reset loop, and prepare for the first real Evolution choice.
item.multiplierEffect: Base fruit stage before Evolution multipliers
item.incomeSourceNaming: Lemon Stand, LemonDash, Lemon Depot, Lemon Trading, Lemon Labs, Lemon Robotics, Lemon Republic, and Lemon or Orange X naming before later theme changes
item.investorResetImpact: Investors build during normal Ascend/Rebirth progress; no Evolution reset happens before this starting stage

item.name: Orange
item.cardSummary: Orange is the first evolved fruit theme. It is the point where the speed boost has to be weighed against losing your current Investor count.
item.requirement: First Evolution after deep investment progress
item.incomeSourceNaming: Orange Stand, Orange Dash, Orange Depot, Orange Trading, Orange Labs, Orange Robotics, Orange Republic, and Orange X
item.investorResetImpact: Evolution resets Investor count, so the 42x jump should be weighed against the Investor bonus being lost

item.name: Lime
item.cardSummary: Lime is the later tracked fruit theme. It belongs to deeper runs where Investor progress, Ascend timing, and Evolution speed all matter together.
item.requirement: Later Evolution stage after Orange and deep investor progress
item.incomeSourceNaming: Lime-themed versions of the same Stand, Dash, Depot, Trading, Labs, Robotics, Republic, and X source ladder
item.investorResetImpact: Evolution still resets Investor count; push enough Investor progress before committing to the stage jump
